title: Catalog search p95 went from 80 ms to 4 s and pods fail health checks
scenario: The morning after catalog-search added promotion badges through a vendor SDK, search latency jumped 50x, liveness probes failed on every pod and doubling the replicas did nothing. The DBA points at a slow query. Find the real cause and ship a fix that keeps the badges.
task: Find the root cause in the stack dump, probe events and latency table
Explain why health checks fail and why scale-out did not help; rule the slow query in or out
Fix the endpoint so no request can stall the event loop; bound and degrade the promotions call
Prove it with make demo and tests; write ANSWER.md
acceptance: /healthz answers in under 200 ms while slow searches run
Slow or failing PromoHub returns results with promotions_degraded true within 0.8 s
Root cause named precisely with quoted evidence; red herring ruled out

practices.label: Week 2 - dependency injection and testing with overrides
